svg.text: A normal (first) request skips the red boxes.
TPageService raises this just before the page runs, after the page is
created and its initial properties are set. A module attaches a handler here
to reach the page and its request as each page is created and processed.
Page construction has initialized the page properties from the page
configuration. The page hierarchy is not available yet. Usage: set
initRecursive() creates the child controls and establishes the page
hierarchy. onInit is raised on every control. Usage: create dynamic
The page hierarchy is ready. Usage: create dynamic controls.
Restore the view state and the control state of the page hierarchy.
Controls load their post data. loadPostData() is invoked for controls that
The post data is loaded and the page state is restored. Usage: create
loadRecursive() runs the main request handling. onLoad is raised on every
control. Usage: perform work that needs the post data and the restored
Dynamically created controls load their post data. loadPostData() is
invoked for controls that implement IPostBackDataHandler.
Controls raise their data-changed events. raisePostDataChangedEvent() is
invoked for controls that implement IPostBackDataHandler and whose data
The control responsible for the request raises its event. A postback raises
the postback event (raisePostBackEvent, such as a button click, on a
control that implements IPostBackEventHandler). A callback runs the
callback event through the control's adapter instead
The post data is completely processed.
preRenderRecursive() does the final preparation for rendering.
onPreRender is raised on every control. Usage: register postback controls
savePageState() saves the view state and the control state of the page
The page hierarchy is rendered. renderControl() is invoked recursively on
the controls. A callback renders only a partial response instead
Unload the page and its hierarchy. onUnload is raised on every control.
